description: Header file defining a templated implementation of the PCG random number generator engine, including parameter classes, mixing functions, and specific engine type aliases.

classes.name: pcg_engine
classes.description: Templated class implementing a PCG random number generator engine with customizable parameters and mixing function.

classes.name: pcg128_params
classes.description: Parameter class providing multiplier and increment for 128-bit PCG engine.

classes.name: pcg_xsl_rr_128_64
classes.description: Mixing function for 128-bit PCG engine producing 64-bit output.

classes.name: pcg64_params
classes.description: Parameter class providing multiplier and increment for 64-bit PCG engine.

classes.name: pcg_xsh_rr_64_32
classes.description: Mixing function for 64-bit PCG engine producing 32-bit output.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates the next random number by advancing the state and applying the mixing function.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Initializes the generator state with a seed value or seed sequence.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the state by a specified number of steps.
